headline: Apple confirms October 13 smart-home launch event
summary: Reports said Apple was partnering with LG on smart-home devices including a lock, doorbell and thermostat, rumored for an October event. Apple then officially announced an October 13 'Welcome home' event in New York, confirming the smart-home focus outlets had reported.

claims.statement: Apple was reportedly partnering with LG on smart-home devices including a lock, doorbell and thermostat.

sources.quote: Apple and LG team up on new smart home gear, starting with a lock, doorbell, and thermostat
Apple is reportedly partnering with LG to launch a smart lock, thermostat, and doorbell

claims.statement: The LG-branded products were expected to launch alongside Apple's own rumored smart home hub.

sources.quote: feature LG branding but integrate with the company's rumored smart home hub that's expected to launch during an event on October 13th

claims.statement: Images of the rumored smart home products, including a lock, thermostat and temperature sensor, later surfaced.

sources.quote: We now have images of the smart home products that Apple and LG are reportedly cooking up
These include a lock, a thermostat and a temperature sensor.

claims.statement: Apple officially announced an October 13 event in New York with a 'Welcome home' tagline, confirming a smart-home focus.

sources.quote: Apple announces surprise ‘Welcome home’ launch event
taking place in New York on October 13th at 9AM ET

claims.statement: Engadget confirmed Apple would show off new smart home devices at the October 13 event, set for 9AM ET.

sources.quote: Apple is set to show off new smart home devices at an October 13 event
The event is set for 9AM ET.
